about: Which file of a piece's run owns which thing. The revision changes a thing in the file that owns it, and where the brief carries the same words, in the brief too. Paths are inside the piece's run folder; the first one that exists is used.

video.what: the hook lines and their options
the spoken script, beat by beat (placement, expansion, close)
the middle of the script, when it is kept in its own file
the close and the offer line, when it is kept in its own file
the spiced script: the lines after the spice pass
the one document the maker opens: scenes, lines, shots, cast, look, sound
who is on screen: in the brief's cast part
how it looks: in the brief's look, scene and shot parts
the owner's locked script: his own words; changed only when he gives the exact words
what we say in the swipe's form: the product, the claim, the angle
the read of the swipe itself: beats, hook, why it works

email.what: the subject lines and preview text
the order of the email's parts
the close and the call to action
the email's words, block by block
the design brief the email is built from
what the email says: the product, the claim, the angle
